A higher self‑BLEU score indicates more tokens from the sources are retained, henceforth, better preservation of the contents. In addition, we also use ref‑BLEU, which compares the system outputs and the references written by human beings.

We use the same evaluation metrics as in previous work : (i) style accuracy (Acc) which measures the transfer intensity; (ii) self-BLEU which measures the content preservation by comparing inputs and outputs of a system; and (iii) ref-BLEU which compares the system outputs and the references written by human beings.

We also conduct human evaluation to assess the quality of the transferred sentences. We randomly sample 100 transferred sentences from each model and ask three human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate each sentence in terms of (i) fluency, (ii) preservation, and (iii) transfer intensity on a 1-5 scale.
